verified_boundaries: Empty query/no match is not a successful knowledge tool result; timeout/backend error is unavailable.
Current lookup replaces factual grounding; miss, weak coverage, and unavailable revoke earlier facts.
Delayed old lookup and old result waiting for playback cannot return old facts as matched.
Only source-containing sufficiently covered non-poisoned passages authorize figures; amount conditions are retained.
Admission-pinned source revision is explicitly labeled and never replaced by a new storage lookup mid-call.
OpenAI and hidden opt-in xAI actual serializers preserve status, source identity and fenced data with fake websocket transport.
Retrieved instruction text cannot authorize an unavailable transfer tool.
Runtime evidence logging emits statuses/counts/source-reference digest without query/body content; exact digest survives redaction.
limitations: Deterministic fake-model admission tests do not establish provider semantic accuracy or audible caller experience.
Existing injection detection and numeric/link guards cannot prove all qualitative claims or all prompt-injection resistance.
Only latest matched lookup grounds a response; facts from another lookup must be retrieved again. Admission snapshots intentionally remain pinned for the call.
Full AG02 approval remains dependent on the reviewed shared retrieval matrix, actual DB isolation/version acceptance and later AG04 provider/telephone profile qualification.
No migration, deployment, saved/default model change or live provider action was performed.
